consumer: The NPC dialogue gate's u_has_items condition lambda built in condition.cpp::set_has_items, which asks the engine 'does the alpha (player) actor have id_card on their person?' and the engine EVALUATES that yes/no.
scope: only the character's own carried items — wielded weapon, worn items, and personal inventory (on-person), NOT nearby/reachable items
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items — its lambda calls actor->has_charges/has_amount on the dialogue actor, which for a Character traverses primary_weapon + worn + inv per visitable<Character>::visit_items, i.e. exactly the on-person reach the gate needs.
divergence: The id_card is lying on an adjacent floor tile (or in a nearby reachable container) but NOT on the player's body: the on-person dialogue predicate must return false, whereas a mission::is_complete-style crafting_inventory() answer (broader reach) would wrongly return true and open the door.
